headline: Honour them this weekend.
sub: Not a rule to feel bad about. A visit to make.
content:
Honour your father and your mother — most of us grew up with the words.

The practical version is smaller than it sounds. This weekend, go. Take the kids. Take a cake. Forty minutes.

Whoever goes, log it — and the whole family breathes out. 💚
notes: Belief 5: honour your parents, made practical. No link; warmth.
